column3: “porpoise skins” renders “tahash skins,” and “the screening veil” renders “the curtain of the screen.”
“the mercy seat” renders “kapporet,” the atonement cover.
“the bread of the Presence” renders “the bread of the face.”
NASB supplies “gold” in “the pure gold lampstand”; “its arrangement of lamps” renders “the lamps of the row.”
“the veil for the doorway” renders “the screen of the entrance.”
“the woven garments” renders “garments of serad,” a word whose meaning is uncertain.
